title: MDF 402 Payment Required response body (x402 v2)
description: Describes the JSON body a server emits with a 402 Payment Required response to an Accept: text/markdown request, and the same object carried base64-encoded in the PAYMENT-REQUIRED response header. The body is an x402 v2 PaymentRequired (specs/x402-specification-v2.md §5.1, at x402-foundation/x402 commit 513dd66d2b3eb2388065f9923d81aa496e626082) with MDF's own fields under the `mdf` key of `extensions` (§5.1.2). This schema describes server output; it places no obligation on consumers. Note that `format` is annotation-only in Draft 2020-12 unless the validator registers a format plugin — the accompanying `pattern` on each string field is the load-bearing constraint. Unlike x402 core, this schema requires the `mdf` extension entry, because the MDF price summary is a normative part of an MDF 402. Strictness profile: the root object is closed (`additionalProperties: false`) so that a v1-shaped field left at the top level is reported rather than silently tolerated; each `accepts[]` entry is open, because a non-standard rail may legitimately carry guidance fields and one unknown entry must never fail the whole offer; and `extensions` stays open to other extension keys, with only the `mdf` entry defined strictly here.

x402Version.description: x402 protocol version. MDF 0.3.0 is x402 v2 only; there is no v1 mode.

error.description: Human-readable explanation of why payment is required, e.g. 'PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header is required'. Advisory only; never parse this to extract price.

accepts.description: One entry per configured rail. A rail that cannot currently be offered is omitted, never replaced with a placeholder; if no rail can be offered the response is not a 402.

extensions.description: x402 v2 protocol extensions. MDF requires its own entry under the key `mdf` and defines that entry strictly, but the map itself stays open: any other extension key (for example `bazaar`) is permitted and passes through untouched. This is the schema's strictness profile — closed root, open accepts[] entries, open extension map.

resourceInfo.description: x402 v2 ResourceInfo. `url` is the one field in a 402 a consumer cannot reconstruct once the response is separated from the request that produced it.

url.description: Absolute URL of the resource being priced, including query string. MUST equal the URL the client requested.

description.description: Human-readable description of the protected resource.

mimeType.description: MIME type of the expected response, e.g. text/markdown.

serviceName.description: Human-readable name of the service hosting the resource. Printable ASCII, max 32 characters.

tags.description: Topical tags for discovery filtering. Max 5 entries; each printable ASCII, max 32 characters.

iconUrl.description: Absolute http(s) URL to an icon representing the service.

paymentRequirements.description: An x402 v2 PaymentRequirements object. `scheme` and `network` are deliberately open: an entry on a network or scheme MDF does not define is out of scope, and a consumer should skip it rather than fail the whole offer. The two rails MDF defines (`exact` on eip155, `exact` on lnbtc) are constrained by the conditionals at the end of this definition. A non-`exact` scheme defines its own asset identifier and may name its network with a bounded opaque identifier; `exact` requires a CAIP-2 network and a token contract address. This schema bounds those fields rather than enumerating them.

scheme.description: x402 payment scheme, e.g. 'exact'. MDF defines 'exact'; any other scheme is carried as the publisher's own rail and is not evaluated by MDF.

network.description: Settlement network for this rail. An 'exact' rail MUST use a CAIP-2 identifier, namespace:reference — the pattern x402 v2 uses (typescript/packages/core/src/schemas/index.ts, NetworkSchemaV2); MDF uses eip155:8453, eip155:84532 and lnbtc:000000000019d6689c085ae165831e93. A non-'exact' scheme MAY name its network with an opaque bounded identifier (for example 'monad-testnet' alongside a `chainId`), which SHOULD still be CAIP-2 and which a consumer normalises before comparing against mdf.json. mdf.json itself always uses CAIP-2.

amount.description: Required payment amount in the asset's atomic units, as an integer decimal string: micro-USDC for a 6-decimal stablecoin, millisatoshis for Lightning. No sign, decimal point, exponent, separator or unit suffix.

asset.description: The asset paid on this rail, as the scheme identifies it: a token contract address (0x-prefixed, 40 hex digits) on an 'exact' EVM rail, the asset symbol 'BTC' on 'exact' lnbtc, or — on any other scheme — the opaque identifier that scheme defines (for example 'native' for a gas-token rail). Never a fiat currency code and never a display name.

payTo.description: Recipient for this rail: an EVM address for an eip155 rail, the receiver node's compressed secp256k1 public key for the lnbtc rail.

maxTimeoutSeconds.description: Maximum time allowed for payment completion. On the lnbtc rail the BOLT11 invoice expiry MUST equal this value.

extra.description: Scheme-specific data, passed through to the facilitator's /verify and /settle. Opaque to MDF except where a scheme below requires a member.

payTo.description: Compressed secp256k1 public key of the receiving Lightning node: 33 bytes as 66 lowercase hex characters, no prefix.

invoice.description: Fresh signed BOLT11 invoice for `amount` on `network`. Its expiry MUST equal maxTimeoutSeconds.

requestHash.description: SHA-256 of the JCS-canonicalised request binding object, which MUST equal the invoice's signed description hash.

extra.description: Required members follow specs/schemes/exact/scheme_exact_lnbtc.md, which is authoritative for invoice construction, request binding and replay. MDF does not restate them. This branch is keyed on the `lnbtc:` namespace, so it covers every lnbtc network the upstream scheme defines — MDF names no testnet of its own.

mdfExtension.description: MDF's extension entry, in the structure x402 v2 §5.1.2 defines for every extension: `info` carries the data, `schema` is a JSON Schema describing it.

schema.description: JSON Schema for `info`. A live response MUST include one that describes the info object it actually emits. The authoritative copy is $defs/mdfExtensionInfo in this file.

mdfExtensionInfo.description: MDF's own 402 fields. Snake_case, and scoped to the extension: nothing here restates accepts[].amount, accepts[].payTo or accepts[].network in machine-readable form.

version.description: MDF specification version this response conforms to, MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH. For 0.3.0 that is '0.3.0'.

expires_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp after which this offer is no longer valid. Optional (a server SHOULD emit it): each rail's maxTimeoutSeconds, and on the lnbtc rail the BOLT11 invoice expiry that must equal it, already bound when the offer can be paid. Where both are present, expires_at MUST NOT outlive the rail's own bounded validity.

price_summary.description: Human-readable price summary, derived from accepts[] and required to agree with it. Descriptive only: no structured amount, payTo or network member appears here.

auth_endpoint.description: Present where payment at this tier issues a bearer credential rather than delivering content immediately. This is the same location /mdf.json declares as auth.endpoint for a section whose price entry carries access: token.

token_estimate.description: Optional heuristic token estimate. Never authoritative. If present, token_estimate_note MUST also be present.

token_estimate_note.description: Description of the estimation method, e.g. 'chars/4 approximation'.

byteCount.description: A byte length. Bounded to reject implausible values from an untrusted origin.

reduction_pct.description: (1 - markdown_bytes / source_bytes) * 100, one decimal place. May be negative where conversion increases size.
